verdict.rationale: Square's marketing pages say it uses machine learning to spot and block payment fraud and lets sellers set custom rules and alerts to manage risk. That covers the core of the story, but only at a glancing, marketing level, with no docs on how screening or rules actually work. Missing for 10: evidence that per-transaction ML fraud scores are visible to the user, distinct block/review/allow rule actions, documentation of rule configuration (UI or API), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
